title: A maximal Jacobian minor from the smooth fibre of a localized presentation
statement: Let $R$ and $S$ be commutative rings with an $R$-algebra structure on $S$, $q$ a prime of $S$, $g\in S$, and $q_g$ a prime of $S_g$ whose inverse image is $q$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime]. Let $n,c\ge0$, $f: \{1,\ldots,c\}\to R[x_1,\ldots,x_n]$, and assume this specified presentation is a relative global complete intersection [def-weil-pbc-relative-global-complete-intersection]. Suppose $e:S_g\cong_R T=R[x_1,\ldots,x_n]/(f)$ is an algebra isomorphism. Put $p=q\cap R$, and suppose $\kappa(p)\otimes_R S$ is smooth at the fibre prime corresponding to $q$ [def-weil-pbc-singular-ideal]. Then there is a strictly increasing choice of $c$ column indices $i:\{1,\ldots,c\}\to\{1,\ldots,n\}$ for which the image in $T$ of $\det(\partial f_j/\partial x_{i(k)})_{j,k}$ is not in the prime $q_T=e(q_g)$ [def-weil-pbc-polynomial-partial-derivative].

source.place: Proof of Lemma Tag 00TF, localized presentation and fibre Jacobian comparison; Lemma Tag 00TE

proof.text: Put p = q ∩ R, k = κ(p), T = R[x]/(f), and fbar_j = map(algebraMap R k)(f_j). Apply the existing relative-global-complete-intersection base-change theorem (00SS (1)) to obtain a k-algebra equivalence ebar : k[x]/(fbar) ≃ k ⊗_R T with ebar(x_j) = 1 ⊗ x_j, and the relative-global-complete-intersection presentation condition for fbar.

source.place: Lemma 00SS (lemma-base-change-relative-global-complete-intersection), part (1); used in the fibre presentation in the proof of 00TF

proof.text: Let Q be the prime of p.Fiber S corresponding to q. Its contraction under includeRight is q by the inverse law for preimageEquivFiber. The image of g is a unit in S_g, hence g avoids q and 1 ⊗ g avoids Q. Lift Q to Qg in the principal localization at 1 ⊗ g. Tensor e with k and use IsLocalization.Away.tensorProductEquivTMulRight to form E : k[x]/(fbar) ≃ (p.Fiber S)_(1 ⊗ g).

source.place: Proof of Lemma Tag 00TF, localized presentation and fibre Jacobian comparison; Lemma Tag 00TE

proof.text: Choose h outside Q such that the fibre localized at h is smooth. Further localization at the image of 1 ⊗ g is smooth by Smooth.of_isLocalization_Away and Smooth.comp. The two orders of localization are both localizations at (1 ⊗ g)*h, so their algebra equivalence makes the fibre localized first at 1 ⊗ g smooth at Qg. Transport this principal smooth neighbourhood along E to the prime Qbar = comap E Qg. The two private helper proofs smoothAt_away and smoothAt_comap_equiv perform these constructions explicitly.

source.place: Proof of Lemma Tag 00TF, localized presentation and fibre Jacobian comparison; Lemma Tag 00TE

proof.text: Apply isSmoothAtPrime_iff_exists_jacobian_minor to fbar and Qbar, using the complete-intersection condition from step 1 and smoothness from step 3. Obtain a strictly increasing selection i of c columns and the corresponding reduced Jacobian minor outside Qbar.

source.place: Proof of Lemma Tag 00TF, localized presentation and fibre Jacobian comparison; Lemma Tag 00TE

proof.text: Extend the variable formula for ebar to every original polynomial using MvPolynomial.algHom_ext on the two R-algebra homomorphisms. Contract Qg along the localization-tensor equivalence and includeRight to get a prime qc of S_g. Its contraction to S is q, by the tensor-localization formula and the contractions of Qg and Q. Injectivity of localization contraction identifies qc with qg. Consequently mk(map a) belongs to Qbar exactly when mk(a) belongs to comap e.symm qg. Finally MvPolynomial.pderiv_map and RingHom.map_det identify the reduced minor with map of the original minor; this membership equivalence pulls the nonmembership back. All these compatibility equalities are proved in the Lean body.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_jacobian_minor_of_smooth_fibre_localizedPresentation
    {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    (q : PrimeSpectrum S) (g : S)
    (qg : PrimeSpectrum (Localization.Away g))
    (hqg : PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap S (Localization.Away g)) qg = q)
    (n c : ℕ) (f : Fin c → MvPolynomial (Fin n) R)
    (hci : IsRelativeGlobalCompleteIntersectionPresentation f)
    (e : Localization.Away g ≃ₐ[R]
      (MvPolynomial (Fin n) R ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range f)))
    (hsmooth : IsSmoothAtPrime (q.comap (algebraMap R S)).asIdeal.ResidueField
      (PrimeSpectrum.preimageEquivFiber R S (q.comap (algebraMap R S)) ⟨q, rfl⟩)) :
    ∃ i : Fin c → Fin n, StrictMono i ∧
      Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span (Set.range f))
        (Matrix.det (fun j k : Fin c ↦ MvPolynomial.pderiv (i k) (f j))) ∉
          (PrimeSpectrum.comap e.symm.toRingHom qg).asIdeal
